section_role: Ablation studies and analysis of CubiD

method_evidence.claim: Masking ratio r is sampled from a truncated Gaussian distribution with μ=1.0 and varying σ.
method_evidence.anchor: We sample the masking ratio r from a truncated Gaussian distribution (Eq.2) with μ = 1.O and varying standard deviation o.

method_evidence.claim: Per-element masking independently masks individual elements across the h×w×d tensor.
method_evidence.anchor: Perelement masking,our approach that independently masks individual elements across the tensor.

method_evidence.claim: Learned mask token achieves best performance.
method_evidence.anchor: Learned: treating the mask token as a learnable parameter. The learned mask token achieves the best performance (gFID=5.33).

experiment_evidence.claim: Optimal masking ratio standard deviation σ=0.10 achieves gFID=5.33.
Per-element masking achieves gFID=5.33, outperforming per-dim (120.03) and per-spatial (22.22).
Learned mask token achieves gFID=5.33, random mask token achieves 56.38.
Performance saturates around 512 inference steps with gFID=5.25.
3.7B model achieves gFID=4.68, improving over 946M (5.25) and 1.4B (4.91).
